title: Homology / Logical-Basis Computation
interpretation: The combined 44 face rows plus 6 distance/parity rows improve the raw six-row compiler from distance 2 to classical check-code distance 4, with 18 payload logical cycles and 6 parity/gauge degrees. This still does not prove a quantum stabilizer/subsystem distance theorem.
boundary: Exact GF3 linear algebra for the classical check complex only; quantum logical operator commutation and CSS distance remain future work.
